WITH player_awards_with_hand AS (
  SELECT pa.player_id, p.bats
  FROM player_award pa
  JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
),
player_hand_counts AS (
  SELECT player_id, bats, COUNT(*) as player_award_count
  FROM player_awards_with_hand
  GROUP BY player_id, bats
),
hand_totals AS (
  SELECT bats, SUM(player_award_count) as hand_total
  FROM player_hand_counts
  GROUP BY bats
),
overall AS (
  SELECT SUM(hand_total) as total
  FROM hand_totals
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ht.bats, 
    ht.hand_total,
    CAST(ht.hand_total AS FLOAT) / o.total as share
  FROM hand_totals ht
  CROSS JOIN overall o
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM with_shares
)
SELECT 
  ws.bats,
  ws.hand_total,
  ws.share,
  ws.share - av.avg_share as share_minus_avg
FROM with_shares ws
CROSS JOIN average_share av
WHERE ws.share > av.avg_share
ORDER BY ws.bats
